subject.title: Fix automatic quota display priority for exhausted windows & Antigravity session preference

question: Should Antigravity’s automatic menu-bar display permanently become Gemini-session/Gemini-weekly only, including removal of the previous cross-family preference behavior?
rationale: The branch intentionally narrows a user-visible provider contract rather than repairing a mechanical parsing defect; code review cannot determine whether existing Claude/GPT quota visibility and preference behavior should be retained, migrated, or retired.

options.title: Preserve the existing contract
options.body: Keep the existing selectable multi-family/preference behavior and limit this PR to the exhausted-window fix plus any independently safe Pace % work.

options.title: Approve Gemini-only status
options.body: Adopt Gemini-only automatic status, but explicitly migrate or remove affected settings, align all visible labels, preserve compact fallback behavior, and document the compatibility change.

options.title: Defer the simplification
options.body: Split the broad Antigravity policy change from the narrow exhausted-window fix until product direction is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Preserve the existing contract
recommendation.body: Keep the existing selectable multi-family/preference behavior and limit this PR to the exhausted-window fix plus any independently safe Pace % work.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a provider UX and compatibility decision rather than a mechanical patch repair.
